root_cause: Current incident preflight checks skill markers and policy flags, but does not enforce a complete Lean/PDCA action-to-outcome event contract for every agent, runtime edge function and portal metric. Live coverage is not proven.
fix: Extend existing incident policy and its mandatory preflight to require an eight-stage Lean loop, canonical evidence ownership, action audit fields and a missing-data rule. No duplicate store or scheduler.
prevention_rule: Agent cannot pass policy preflight if it disables continuous learning, source ownership, evidence fields, one-writer authority, independent outcome proof or missing-data UNKNOWN guard.
terminal_rule: Require exact-head Required/BRAIN/CodeQL, protected single-writer merge, independent production preflight and runtime/portal source readback before calling this rule live. Zero reported CTA clicks does not prove zero real clicks; no business lift claim.
